bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge BigBang
bricks.description: Preview independent Editor prerequisite and initial God installer. Separate local Check prerequisites and Get Latest Git Source actions restore installation eligibility after compilation/reload. Resolves the latest compatible published God release and freezes its verified commit. Supports long Windows input paths, reports fingerprint read errors and completes cached-only incremental compilation without waiting for a reload. Hands over to God's built-in Commandments view without acquiring content. Visual/keyboard acceptance remains incomplete under explicit user instruction.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Commandments Compatibility
bricks.description: Passive Editor API compatibility adapter for existing Companion installations. God 0.29.0 owns Commandments tools; fresh projects do not need this adapter.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge God
bricks.description: Game Forge God package management, installed tools embedded inside God with pinned Back navigation, Build Forge setup, built-in Commandments viewing and confirmed updates, lifecycle, settings and optional scene-startup/input cooperation. Supplies neutral optional Settings catalogue, menu-authoring and preview contracts with verified module eligibility, plus ordinary bootstrap-owned hosts and a scene-owned console accessor. Adds cached Editor findings, parent-aware nested sections, optional read-only settings-rule registration and boxed collapsible tool content with visible state/severity icons. Supported build-time preservation retains unreferenced installed brick roots without adding an initializer or changing authored content. Native God suite512/0/2 and EditorPlay/WindowsMonoLow/IL2CPPHigh38/38 passed, including unreferenced SaveLoad and Audio discovery; remaining owner adoption and full appearance acceptance remain unverified. Existing projects explicitly review the saved console configuration after manual installation.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Diagnostics
bricks.description: God-owned runtime logging, Quantum Console channels and commands, session history, health checks, read-only inspection, Windows performance metrics and Odin Editor tooling. Runtime hosts use the ordinary retained bootstrap; shared read-only preference rules, exact-type optional God settings registration and collapsible authoring with inactive severity summaries use God 0.33.0. Native Diagnostics74/74, console10/10, embedded10/10, EditorPlay34/34 and WindowsMono/IL2CPP34/34 passed. Full rendered/physical appearance acceptance remains unverified.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Settings System
bricks.description: Preview: no-code typed settings, reviewed field and consumer connections, owned runtime configuration copies, one central panel and isolated synchronized Auto Settings Menu previews. Automated authoring/lifecycle and Mono/IL2CPP acceptance passed; native visual/input acceptance remains unverified.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Scene Loading and Bootstrap
bricks.description: Bootstrap-first startup, scene groups, asset-authored later scene changes and reusable loading presentations, readiness and recovery, with optional UI Foundations callbacks, pooling lifecycle and multiplayer integration points. Cached per-selected-object inline authoring uses boxed collapsible sections with hidden severity text/icons through God 0.33.0, retaining draft controls and ordinary bootstrap ownership. Native Editor135/0/1, embedded10/10 and Editor Play/Windows Mono/IL2CPP34/34 passed. Full rendered/physical acceptance remains unverified.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Save and Load
bricks.description: Informational starter; planned gameplay save/load features remain unimplemented. Native boxed labelled foldouts retain closed Information icons, pinned starter status and safe independent God embedding without package-action restoration or scene/settings mutation. God0.33.1 supports actual automatic player discovery. Native5/5, embedded11/11 and EditorPlay/WindowsMonoLow/IL2CPPHigh38/38 passed; full rendered/physical acceptance remains unverified.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Audio
bricks.description: Shared bootstrap-owned playback and Unity-default clips with optional FMOD assignments. God0.33 cached read-only rules, boxed sections, inactive severity/icons, retained defaults drafts and embedded package suppression. Native25/25, EditorPlay88/88, embedded11/11 and WindowsMono/IL2CPP88/88 passed. Full rendered/physical acceptance and vendor lifetime remain unverified.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge User Interface Foundations
bricks.description: Preview: Panel Renderer and retained UI Document menus with selected Settings catalogues, reviewed persistent menu connections and shared isolated preview rendering. Settings remains optional. Native visual/input acceptance remains unverified.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Object Pooling
bricks.description: Prefab pooling with generation-bound leases, bounded preparation/shrinking and ordinary retained-bootstrap ownership. Editor authoring shares cached runtime/project rules, per-object inline findings, boxed collapsible Odin/Toolkit sections and workflow tabs with inactive severity text/icons. Editor 70/70, God-embedded 9/9 and Windows Mono/IL2CPP 34/34 checks passed. Full rendered/physical-input acceptance remains unverified; existing content is preserved and updates are installed manually.
